headline: Deadlocked gains PAL matching work and easier external-disc extraction
summary: Contributors can now extract a PAL disc image from an explicit path without copying it into the checkout (#56). Merged matching work covers PAL drawing, object data, table lookups, smoothing and state helpers, including 17 hash lookups in #72 and 22 functions in #75. A matched function compiles to the same bytes as the original game; the snapshot's headline progress remains 6.07% of code and 4,475 of 18,085 functions, without identifying its release, so it should not be read as the PAL total.
highlights: #57 explicitly reports PAL SCES_532.85 moving from 5,138 to 5,140 matched functions with its two drawing wrappers.
The 45 NTSC-U helpers in #71 remain a draft awaiting PAL mapping; the author lacks PAL retail inputs.
Further PAL batches #55, #77, #78 and #79 remain open rather than merged.
Research issue #73 distinguishes matching functions from reconstruction drafts: its 13,713 generated ranges are not 13,713 decompiled functions.
